dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides parcel-level cadastre for Westbank First Nation lands. It includes parcel polygons and related linework used to represent legal land boundaries, parcel locations, and associated land records.

Content

  • Parcel boundaries and supporting linework for land administration and mapping.
  • Reference information such as legal descriptions, folio details, civic address components, parcel identifiers.
  • Area and positional accuracy attributes that support interpretation of parcel extent and confidence in mapped geometry.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation area within the Central Okanagan region of British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Viewing and identifying parcel boundaries and legal land information.
  • Supporting land administration, planning, and cadastral reference workflows.
  • Locating parcels by address, plan, lot, or related property identifiers.
  • Reviewing parcel attributes for zoning, land use, and basic property context.

Data Notes

Distances and areas should be treated as approximate.
